name: agent-dealer
description: Issue queue and execution control plane for coding agents — admission, developer/reviewer workflow, audit treasure

scripts.dev: AGENT_DEALER_ENV=development concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @agent-dealer/server" "npm run dev -w @agent-dealer/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @agent-dealer/shared && npm run build -w @agent-dealer/server && npm run build -w @agent-dealer/web
scripts.test:unit: AGENT_DEALER_SKIP_GITHUB_HEALTH=1 AGENT_DEALER_SKIP_AGENT_HEALTH=1 npm run build -w @agent-dealer/shared && AGENT_DEALER_SKIP_GITHUB_HEALTH=1 AGENT_DEALER_SKIP_AGENT_HEALTH=1 tsx --test $(find packages -name '*.test.ts' -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -not -path '*/dist/*') && npm run test -w @agent-dealer/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @agent-dealer/shared && npm run typecheck -w @agent-dealer/server && npm run typecheck -w @agent-dealer/web
